description: The exposure report for a private Exposure Ledger workspace (created at https://shop.tensorust.com/exposure/workspace): every stored vendor payment / PO line re-scored against today's lists, totals by vendor and rule, prohibited-use and review lines, and the join to the ledger (corroborated awards; ledger awards with no purchase line). Needs the workspace token (xlw_...). Free.
